intent: Use only an unreadable fragment that supports several visual interpretations. Avoid recognizable words, logos or exact earlier panel geometry that would resolve its origin.
source:
**Frame:** An indistinct fragment flickers in available context: it could be a panel border, an incident report diagram, a generic example, or compression noise. No words are legible.

**Provenance:** `invented` — ambiguity architecture. The panel is uncaptioned on purpose; see the page notes.
title: An unreadable context fragment remains ambiguous
